response.text: Under the RBI Directions for Commercial Banks, the Board (or a delegated Committee) must approve a framework to evaluate the risks and materiality of all existing and prospective outsourcing arrangements, along with the applicable policies [6]. The Board is specifically responsible for deciding on business activities of a material nature to be outsourced and approving such arrangements [6]. Additionally, the Board must approve a comprehensive outsourcing policy that incorporates criteria for selection, parameters for defining material outsourcing, delegation of authority, and monitoring systems [1][5].
